islands.name: 01-terraform-multi-az-vpc
islands.title: Multi-AZ three-tier VPC module
islands.summary: Terraform module for a three-tier, multi-AZ AWS VPC with NAT strategy, S3/DynamoDB and ECR/STS endpoints, and flow logs

islands.name: 02-ansible-linux-hardening
islands.title: CIS-subset Linux hardening roles
islands.summary: Ansible roles that harden Ubuntu and RHEL EC2 fleets to a CIS benchmark subset: SSH lockdown, fail2ban, unattended upgrades, with check-mode and idempotency tests

islands.name: 03-python-ebs-orphan-report
islands.title: Orphaned EBS volume report
islands.summary: Python tool that finds unattached EBS volumes older than N days across an AWS Organization, reports their monthly cost, and writes a CSV for human review. It never deletes.

islands.name: 04-terraform-cross-account-ci-role
islands.title: Cross-account CI role module
islands.summary: Terraform module that creates a least-privilege IAM role a CI pipeline can assume in another AWS account, with an external ID and a trust policy scoped to one role.

islands.name: 05-bash-ebs-snapshot-retention
islands.title: EBS snapshot retention script
islands.summary: Bash script that snapshots EBS volumes tagged Backup=true and prunes only the snapshots it created, past a retention period. Prune is a dry run unless --execute is set.

islands.name: 06-github-actions-image-pipeline
islands.title: Container image pipeline (build, scan, sign)
islands.summary: GitHub Actions pipeline that builds a multi-arch container image, scans it with Trivy, signs it with Cosign, and pushes it to GHCR only from main.

islands.name: 07-semver-tag-action
islands.title: Semantic-version tag action
islands.summary: Reusable GitHub Action that reads conventional commits since the last stable tag, picks the next semantic version, tags HEAD, and creates a GitHub release with the changelog as notes.

islands.name: 08-terraform-plan-policy-check
islands.title: Terraform plan policy check
islands.summary: Python tool that checks a Terraform plan JSON against policy rules (public S3 buckets, required tags, allowed instance types) and fails the pipeline on any violation. Runs on plan output, no AWS calls.

islands.name: 09-argocd-applicationset-kustomize
islands.title: Argo CD ApplicationSet with Kustomize overlays
islands.short: Argo CD ApplicationSet with Kustomize overlays
islands.summary: Argo CD ApplicationSet that renders one Kustomize base into dev, stage and prod Applications. Dev and stage auto-sync, prod syncs manually.

islands.name: 10-terraform-drift-detection
islands.title: Scheduled Terraform drift detection
islands.summary: Scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that runs terraform plan with detailed exit codes, reports infrastructure drift, and posts a short summary to Slack or Teams.

islands.name: 11-helm-12factor-chart
islands.title: 12-factor app Helm chart
islands.summary: Helm chart for a stateless 12-factor app with HPA, PodDisruptionBudget, a NetworkPolicy limited to a labelled namespace, and an ExternalSecret that renders only when secrets are enabled. Values are checked by a schema. Not deployed to any cluster.

islands.name: 12-k8s-configmap-secret-controller
islands.title: ConfigMap-to-Secret sync controller
islands.summary: Python Kubernetes controller that watches ConfigMaps with a sync annotation, reads the named secret from AWS Secrets Manager, and creates or updates a Kubernetes Secret. Tested with a fake secret store, no cluster or AWS calls.

islands.name: 13-python-pod-security-audit
islands.title: Pod security audit CLI
islands.summary: Python CLI that audits Kubernetes pods for privileged containers, hostPath mounts and missing limits

islands.name: 14-helm-observability-sidecar-library
islands.title: Observability sidecar Helm library chart
islands.summary: Helm library chart that adds metrics/logging sidecars and security contexts, with render tests

islands.name: 15-python-networkpolicy-generator
islands.title: NetworkPolicy generator
islands.summary: Python tool that turns a simple intent file into Kubernetes NetworkPolicy manifests

islands.name: 16-lambda-iam-mfa-enforcement
islands.title: IAM MFA enforcement Lambda
islands.summary: AWS Lambda that checks new IAM users for MFA and sends a notification, tested with mocked boto3 clients

islands.name: 17-ansible-ssh-key-rotation
islands.title: SSH key rotation role
islands.summary: Ansible role rotating SSH host keys/authorized_keys, updating inventory, notifying owners, tested

islands.name: 18-terraform-s3-public-remediation
islands.title: Public S3 bucket auto-remediation
islands.summary: Terraform AWS Config rule that detects and remediates public S3 buckets, with tests

islands.name: 19-python-securityhub-jira-aggregator
islands.title: Security Hub to Jira aggregator
islands.summary: Python tool that aggregates and prioritizes Security Hub findings, opens Jira tickets, with fakes

islands.name: 20-precommit-secret-scan
islands.title: Pre-commit secret scanner
islands.summary: Pre-commit hook that blocks commits containing secrets, with tests and CI

islands.name: 21-terraform-prometheus-grafana-stack
islands.title: Prometheus/Grafana/Alertmanager stack module
islands.summary: Terraform module that deploys Prometheus, Grafana and Alertmanager with node and pod health alerts

islands.name: 22-python-metric-anomaly-alerts
islands.title: CloudWatch metric anomaly alerts
islands.summary: Python script that finds CloudWatch metric anomalies with simple statistics and posts Slack alerts, tested with fakes

islands.name: 23-fluentbit-k8s-log-routing
islands.title: Fluent Bit Kubernetes log routing
islands.summary: Fluent Bit DaemonSet config that enriches Kubernetes container logs and routes them to Elasticsearch, S3 and Splunk

islands.name: 24-python-slo-burnrate-metrics
islands.title: SLO burn-rate metrics service
islands.summary: Python service exposing order latency metrics with Prometheus client and SLO burn-rate alert rules, tested with promtool

islands.name: 25-ansible-datadog-agent-rollout
islands.title: Datadog agent rollout role
islands.summary: Ansible role that installs and tags the Datadog agent on mixed Linux and Windows hosts, with APM enabled by a flag, tested with lint and check mode

islands.name: 26-bash-asg-bluegreen-deploy
islands.title: ASG blue/green and canary deploy framework
islands.short: ASG blue/green and canary deploy framework
islands.summary: Bash framework for blue/green and canary deployments of EC2 Auto Scaling Groups, with logging, error handling and dry-run mode

islands.name: 27-python-cloud-tagging-cli
islands.title: Cloud resource tagging CLI
islands.summary: Python CLI that reports and bulk-fixes non-conforming AWS resource tags, with a provider interface stubbed for Azure and GCP. Tested with fakes in CI.

islands.name: 28-lambda-unused-resource-cleanup
islands.title: Unused AWS resource cleanup Lambda
islands.summary: Scheduled Lambda that finds unused Elastic IPs, old AMIs, unattached security groups and orphaned load balancers, with SNS/SQS approval before cleanup

islands.name: 29-azure-resource-group-module
islands.title: Azure resource group PowerShell module
islands.summary: PowerShell module for Azure Resource Groups with consistent naming, locks and budget alerts

islands.name: 30-python-dynamic-ansible-inventory
islands.title: Dynamic Ansible inventory
islands.summary: Python dynamic Ansible inventory script for AWS EC2, with a provider interface stubbed for Azure and GCP. Tested with fakes in CI.

islands.name: 31-python-cost-explorer-report
islands.title: Weekly AWS cost report
islands.summary: Python script that reads two weeks of AWS Cost Explorer spend, finds the top cost drivers by service and by one cost allocation tag, and writes a short Markdown report.

islands.name: 32-lambda-scheduled-instance-stop
islands.title: Scheduled stop for non-production instances
islands.summary: AWS Lambda run by an EventBridge schedule that stops opted-in non-production EC2 and RDS instances outside business hours, with per-resource schedules, timezones and temporary overrides.

islands.name: 33-terraform-mandatory-tag-policy
islands.title: Mandatory cost-allocation tag policy
islands.summary: Terraform module (an S3 bucket) that will not plan unless its cost-allocation tags are complete and well formed, using native variable validation and resource preconditions.

islands.name: 34-python-vm-rightsizing-advisor
islands.title: EC2 rightsizing advisor
islands.summary: Read-only Python tool that reads two weeks of CPU and memory use for running EC2 instances and suggests one size down, one size up or no change, using an editable instance catalog.

islands.name: 35-python-s3-lifecycle-savings-report
islands.title: S3 lifecycle savings report
islands.summary: Read-only Python job that groups S3 objects by age and size and estimates the monthly saving from Intelligent-Tiering or a Standard-IA lifecycle rule, as a Markdown report.

islands.name: 36-terraform-transit-gateway-hub-spoke
islands.title: Transit Gateway hub and spoke
islands.summary: Terraform module for an AWS Transit Gateway hub, an inspection VPC with a Network Firewall endpoint, spoke attachments and route tables that send spoke-to-spoke traffic through the firewall.

islands.name: 37-python-security-group-audit
islands.title: Security group audit
islands.summary: Read-only Python script that assumes a role in each AWS account, reads every security group, writes a CSV of every ingress rule and a Markdown report of rules open to the internet and unused groups.

islands.name: 38-ansible-ipsec-vpn-tunnels
islands.title: IPsec VPN tunnels with Ansible
islands.summary: Ansible playbook and role that set up an IKEv2 site-to-site IPsec tunnel with strongSwan and X.509 certificates, plus a systemd health check that writes a Prometheus metric.

islands.name: 39-python-gitops-dns-reconciler
islands.title: GitOps DNS reconciler
islands.summary: Python tool that keeps Route 53 records in line with a YAML file in Git: it prints a plan and applies it as one change batch only when asked, once or in a loop.

islands.name: 40-terraform-private-api-gateway
islands.title: Private API Gateway module
islands.summary: Terraform module that exposes an internal service through a private API Gateway REST API, a VPC link and an internal Network Load Balancer, with nothing reachable from the internet.

islands.name: 41-python-rds-failover-test
islands.title: Cross-region RDS failover test
islands.summary: Python script that tests disaster recovery by promoting an RDS cross-region read replica, checking application connectivity, timing the failover and writing a Markdown report. Dry run unless --execute is passed.

islands.name: 42-terraform-lambda-cross-region-backup
islands.title: Cross-region EBS snapshot backup
islands.summary: Terraform module and Lambda function that copy the latest snapshot of each tagged EBS volume to a second region on a schedule, encrypted with a KMS key in that region, with retention pruning. Dry run by default.

islands.name: 43-terraform-multiregion-ha-pattern
islands.title: Multi-region active-passive pattern
islands.summary: Terraform module for an active-passive pair of AWS regions: a DynamoDB global table for data and Route 53 failover records with a health check for traffic.

islands.name: 44-python-chaos-engineering-fis
islands.title: Chaos runner for AWS FIS
islands.summary: Python script that runs AWS Fault Injection Service experiments one at a time and checks the system recovers on its own within a time limit. Dry run unless --execute is passed.

islands.name: 45-lambda-ecs-autoremediation
islands.title: ECS auto-remediation Lambda
islands.summary: AWS Lambda that watches ECS services and applies two controlled fixes: a new deployment after a crashed task and a one-task scale-out for unhealthy targets, only on services tagged for it. Dry run by default.

islands.name: 46-gitops-crossplane-monorepo
islands.title: GitOps monorepo with Argo CD and Crossplane
islands.short: GitOps monorepo with Argo CD and Crossplane
islands.summary: One repository meant for Argo CD to manage cloud infrastructure through Crossplane and an application through Kustomize, with a single root Application. Every manifest is rendered and schema-checked.

islands.name: 47-python-opa-compliance-engine
islands.title: OPA compliance engine
islands.summary: Six Rego rules that check cloud resource configurations, a YAML mapping of those rules to SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 control IDs and a Python runner that writes a pass, fail or not-evaluated Markdown report.

islands.name: 48-fastapi-temp-access-portal
islands.title: Temporary access portal
islands.summary: FastAPI backend where developers request temporary access to an allowlisted AWS IAM role, an approver decides, and short-lived STS credentials expire by themselves, with an append-only JSON-lines audit log.

islands.name: 49-python-cmdb-sync-tool
islands.title: AWS Config to CMDB sync
islands.summary: Python tool that pulls the current inventory from AWS Config and keeps a SQLite CMDB in step: new resources inserted, changed ones updated, missing ones soft-retired. Dry run prints the diff.

islands.name: 50-golden-path-env-provisioner
islands.title: Golden path environment provisioner
islands.summary: Template that stands up a greenfield environment (VPC, EKS, observability, sample app) from one parameter file using GitHub Actions, Terraform, Ansible and Kubernetes manifests.

islands.name: aws-3-tier-github-actions
islands.title: AWS three-tier delivery on EC2 and ECS
islands.summary: One FastAPI/MySQL image deployed to both EC2 Auto Scaling and ECS Fargate behind an ALB with Terraform, OIDC GitHub Actions, immutable ECR tags and a load-test workflow.

islands.name: aws-retail-microservices-eks
islands.title: Orbital Expeditions: event-driven microservices on EKS
islands.summary: Six-service fictional storefront on EKS Fargate with DynamoDB reservations, an RDS transactional outbox, Valkey cache, EventBridge to SQS with DLQ, SES email and Prometheus/Grafana.

islands.name: azure-aks-referral-platform
islands.title: Northbridge Health referral platform on Azure
islands.summary: Terraform modules, Helm chart and Azure Pipelines for a referral API and worker on AKS with private endpoints, workload identity and Key Vault.

islands.name: cloud-portfolio
islands.title: Cloud portfolio site
islands.summary: Static GitHub Pages portfolio: one continuous 3D world of project islands in blended climate zones, with a generated case study for every public repository.

islands.name: forest-run-unity-game
islands.title: Forest Run (Unity 3D game)
islands.summary: Team Unity 3D platformer with enemy AI and scoring, built as a Georgia Tech course project (Team SJMSK).

islands.name: gcp-ai-log-analyzer
islands.title: AI Log Analyzer on GCP
islands.summary: Log upload and incident replay dashboard plus a private ADK agent that makes one Gemini call per log on Vertex AI, with Pub/Sub, Firestore, Cloud Storage and BigQuery incident history.

islands.name: github-actions-oidc-s3-pipeline
islands.title: GitHub Actions to AWS over OIDC
islands.summary: Flask app and static site promoted through dev, stage and main with Bandit, pip-audit, Gitleaks and Trivy gates, deployed to S3 with short-lived OIDC credentials.

islands.name: healthcare-eks-secops
islands.title: Healthcare SecOps on EKS
islands.summary: Read-only patient lookup API on EKS Fargate delivered through scan-gated CI, Argo CD GitOps, approval-gated Terraform and OIDC-only access, with a logged controls and exceptions register.
